name: Yaqeen Institute for Islamic Research
mission: Books Yaqeen Books provides high-quality, well-researched Islamic books and ebooks focused on providing practical solutions to contemporary problems.
theoryOfChange: Yaqeen Institute for Islamic Research has developed a 'Yaqeen Compass,' described as a 'groundbreaking framework to help Muslims understand their own religiosity.' This framework aims to gauge religiosity in six key areas and help Muslims reach their fullest potential. The institute states, 'Our theory is that, by studying your example, we can learn how to help others grow in their faith.' The process involves taking an assessment, reflecting on results, accessing resources, and re-taking the assessment after 180 days to track growth.
